boundary: Dedicated local PostgreSQL 16 on 127.0.0.1:55438/routines_phase23, synthetic users/data; business helpers are fixture implementations, not a deployed-business RLS audit.
version: PostgreSQL 16.14 on x86_64-apple-darwin24.6.0, compiled by Apple clang version 17.0.0 (clang-1700.6.3.2), 64-bit

checks.name: propose is inert; confirm is idempotent and schedules strictly after DB clock
strict config disallows raw cron, unknown worker/recipe, fake channel and invalid clock
proposed cannot be resumed as active; disabling proposal never creates an active routine
public RPCs reject NULL versions/fences instead of bypassing CAS through SQL unknown
calendar uses Sao Paulo civil time, weekday/weekend and strictly future instants
catch-up uses only latest occurrence of same local day; older occurrence is skipped
complete_run is atomic, idempotent, keeps rich body only in existing own messages, and cost is unknown
real concurrent confirm returns one active routine and one creation event
real concurrent claims produce one occurrence despite separate request IDs
expiration is evaluated after waiting for a real advisory lock
expired lease reclaims same logical run with new generation; old fence cannot complete
pausing after claim fences success, preserves failed attempt and disallows stale Undo
real pause versus completion serializes under the same advisory lock before validating state
business capability is rechecked after claim; removing grant blocks success and hides alerts
claims share immutable chat admission budget and roll back when capped
quota admits at most 10 active routines, including concurrent resume/confirm serialization
at most two claims are admitted and running leases prevent extra concurrent runs
explicit memory masks PII/URLs, supports CAS + disable, and never invents a conversation
snapshot and RLS bind owner/org; admin aggregates do not expose other users memory or messages
inbox deduplicates own reported condition and marking seen has no business mutation
anonymous/service-role-style claims cannot access workspace, and no token fields are persisted
a NULL auth.role is denied, and the real redactor removes whole compact CNPJ/JWT values
empty executeDue and memory receipts cannot grow without a server metadata quota
